policy: This is an immutable evaluation index, not a replacement GT, model input, prompt, or application rule.
Preserve all original 75 question groups and 99 atomic propositions, including empty-gold cases. Do not revise labels after seeing predictions.
Candidate field IDs are search aids only. Review the exact rendered question and relevant customer context. No field ID grants credit automatically.
For each predicted question, mark every semantically requested gold atom using original 1-based question/fact indexes. Distinct gold atoms count once regardless of duplicate predictions.

Whole-question credit requires a single predicted question that covers the complete corresponding gold group without substituting a different independent decision. Preserve strict grouping; a bundled prediction cannot receive multiple whole-question matches.
Apply one-to-one whole-question matching. Partial-fact matches may refer to multiple gold groups, but cannot silently merge, drop or rename gold atoms.
Facts supplied in the input do not remove their frozen gold questions from this scored reference. Any conflict is an observation, not a label edit.

Do not equate account ownership with backend operation; project existence with product/historical enablement; use geography with billing geography; rates with concurrency/volume; matrix operations with elements; typical with maximum counts; observed responses with desired capabilities.
Unsupported-current-field atoms may match an actual diagnostic question if its wording requests the exact proposition. Otherwise remain unmatched.

Bind final semantic judgements to exact prediction and unchanged gold file hashes with bind_review; rescore with score_bound_review. This is assistant-reviewed evidence, not independent human evaluation.
